subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ + IR runbook and audit package for upcoming Keystone regulator review
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@keystone-ins.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Audit evidence, IR runbook, and SIG/CAIQ for regulator review

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Keystone's regulatory review team has scheduled a documentation pre-pack (for an on-site audit window beginning 2027-04-26). To prepare, they require the following artifacts no later than 2027-04-22: 
- Latest incident response plan (IR runbook) that would apply to a production outage/incident impacting customer data;
- Completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ snapshot;
- Any SOC 2 Type II report available (redacted is fine) or a statement of report availability and date;
- A brief timeline template showing how Redwood handles incident notification to customers (typical SLA and escalation contacts).

Please confirm who will coordinate evidence transfer and whether you can provide a secure SFTP/drive location for files. We may need a short 30-minute call the week of Apr 15 to go over redactions and a signed attestation.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Senior Manager, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Keystone Insurance

--
Attachment request: list of files acceptable (PDF/XLS/JSON).

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@keystone-ins.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Audit evidence, IR runbook, and SIG/CAIQ for regulator review

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up. We're ready to assemble a compliance package for Keystone. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

1) Ownership 
- I will own coordination and delivery.
- Marissa (security) will confirm redactions for logs and control evidence.
- Sean (security ops) will prepare the IR runbook excerpt and timeline template.

2) Deliverables we can provide by Apr 22
- IR runbook export (redacted operational contacts and internal network identifiers) — Redwood_IRP_v3.1.pdf (we will include an excerpt focused on detection/response/playbook).
- SIG matrix export and CAIQ snapshot — SIG_Matrix_Keystone_20270414.xlsx, CAIQ_snapshot_20270414.json.
- SOC 2 note: our most recent SOC 2 Type II report is held by our compliance team; we can provide a redacted PDF or a signed letter confirming the scope and date. Please confirm preference.

3) Transfer method
- We can stage files to a shared Google Drive folder and/or an SFTP drop (we prefer Drive for quicker collaboration; SFTP for formal transfer if your auditors require it). Proposed Drive link (temporary, will expire after transfer): https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/keystone-audit-package

4) Call
- Proposed 30-minute window: Thu Apr 15 10:00–10:30 PT (we'll keep it focused on redaction rules and delivery format). Will that work?

I'll get Marissa and Sean to scope attachments and confirm the log extract we can share.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@keystone-ins.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Audit evidence, IR runbook, and SIG/CAIQ for regulator review

Elena — copying the security artifacts plan. Per Jonas: we'll prepare the following and upload to the Drive folder by EOD Apr 21 at the latest: 

- Redwood_IRP_v3.1.pdf (redacted): includes incident classification, escalation matrix, communication templates, and RTO/RPO guidance.
- SIG_Matrix_Keystone_20270414.xlsx: populated answers; control owner notes will be in the comments.
- CAIQ_snapshot_20270414.json: machine-readable snapshot of controls that map to SIG.
- log_extract_20270401-20270411.tar.gz: sanitized telemetry extract showing alerting and timeline for a benign test event (timestamps preserved; IPs redacted).

Transfer notes: we will first stage everything on the Drive link Jonas shared. If your audit team requires SFTP, we can also place the tarball on a secure SFTP server and provide one-time credentials via your security contact.

For the SOC 2 item: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF or a signed attestation letter. Historically Keystone audits accept a redacted report plus an attestation. If you need the full report under an NDA, let us know and we will route through legal.

Finally, for the attestation we can supply a short DocuSign-ready statement confirming the report scope and effective dates — I will prepare the text if you confirm DocuSign is acceptable.

-Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to be uploaded): Redwood_IRP_v3.1.pdf; SIG_Matrix_Keystone_20270414.xlsx; CAIQ_snapshot_20270414.json; log_extract_20270401-20270411.tar.gz

Thanks Jon/Marissa — that plan looks good. A few confirmations before we proceed: 
- Drive is fine for the initial package; please mark files "Keystone_AUDIT" in the filename.
- We would like a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF plus a one-paragraph signed attestation (DocuSign link is preferred).
- The auditor will accept the sanitized log tarball on SFTP; please send SFTP details and expiry policy when you place the file.
- Confirmed call: Thu Apr 15 10:00 PT — please send calendar invite.

If everything is on track, we will mark HS-43921 as in-progress and share the pre-audit checklist with our external auditor. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena
